This page lists 123 VS Code keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `vscode.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in VS Code to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t vscode.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/vscode.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Visual Studio Code.app`; if VS Code lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘P` | Show Command Palette |
| `F1` | Show Command Palette |
| `⌘P` | Quick Open, Go to File |
| `⇧⌘N` | New window/instance |
| `⌘W` | Close window/instance |
| `⌘,` | User Settings |
| `⌘K⌘S` | Keyboard Shortcuts |

## Basic Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘X` | Cut line (empty selection) |
| `⌘C` | Copy line (empty selection) |
| `⌥↓` | Move line down |
| `⌥↑` | Move line up |
| `⇧⌥↓` | Copy line down |
| `⇧⌥↑` | Copy line up |
| `⇧⌘K` | Delete line |
| `⌘⏎` | Insert line below |
| `⇧⌘⏎` | Insert line above |
| `⇧⌘\` | Jump to matching bracket |
| `⌘]` | Indent line |
| `⌘[` | Outdent line |
| `⌘↑` | Go to beginning of file |
| `⌘↓` | Go to end of file |
| `⌥⌘[` | Fold region |
| `⌥⌘]` | Unfold region |
| `⌘K⌘[` | Fold all subregions |
| `⌘K⌘]` | Unfold all subregions |
| `⌘K⌘0` | Fold all regions |
| `⌘K⌘J` | Unfold all regions |
| `⌘K⌘C` | Add line comment |
| `⌘K⌘U` | Remove line comment |
| `⌘/` | Toggle line comment |
| `⇧⌥A` | Toggle block comment |
| `⌥Z` | Toggle word wrap |

## Multi-cursor & Selection

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥+click` | Insert cursor |
| `⌥⌘↑` | Insert cursor above |
| `⌥⌘↓` | Insert cursor below |
| `⌘U` | Undo last cursor operation |
| `⇧⌥I` | Insert cursor at end of each line |
| `⌘L` | Select current line |
| `⇧⌘L` | Select all occurrences of selection |
| `⌘F2` | Select all occurrences of word |
| `⌃⇧⌘→` | Expand selection |
| `⌃⇧⌘←` | Shrink selection |

## Search & Replace

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘F` | Find |
| `⌥⌘F` | Replace |
| `⌘G` | Find next |
| `⇧⌘G` | Find previous |
| `⌥⏎` | Select all Find matches |
| `⌘D` | Add selection to next Find match |
| `⌘K⌘D` | Move last selection to next Find match |

## Code Intelligence

Works in supported languages.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃Space` | Trigger suggestion |
| `⌘I` | Trigger suggestion |
| `⇧⌘Space` | Trigger parameter hints |
| `⇧⌥F` | Format document |
| `⌘K⌘F` | Format selection |
| `F12` | Go to Definition |
| `⌥F12` | Peek Definition |
| `⌘KF12` | Open Definition to the side |
| `⌘.` | Quick Fix |
| `⇧F12` | Show References |
| `F2` | Rename Symbol |
| `⌘K⌘X` | Trim trailing whitespace |
| `⌘KM` | Change file language |

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | Show all Symbols |
| `⌃G` | Go to Line |

| `⇧⌘O` | Go to Symbol |
| `⇧⌘M` | Show Problems panel |
| `F8` | Go to next error/warning |

| `⌃-` | Go back |
| `⌃⇧-` | Go forward |

| Shortcut | Action |

| `⌘W` | Close editor |

## Debug

Use with debugger attached.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `F9` | Toggle breakpoint |
| `F5` | Start/Continue |
| `F11` | Step into |
| `⇧F11` | Step out |
| `F10` | Step over |
| `⇧F5` | Stop |
| `⌘K⌘I` | Show hover |

## Terminal

Integrated terminal shortcuts.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `` ⌃` `` | Show integrated terminal |
| `` ⌃⇧` `` | Create new terminal |
| `⌘C` | Copy selection |

| `⌘↓` | Scroll down |

## Template file

The full [`vscode.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/vscode.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
